items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Per 3.1.4 and 4.3(d), loss of or damage to property brought about by its being taken away by a third party is not covered, irrespective of means used or location. Clothing and jewellery are also specifically excluded as personal articles under 4.3(d). Reference Case 35 confirms t = 0 for this scenario.

Expenditure connected with a conveyance or with the making of a journey is not an insured cost under 5.1/5.2.5, and vehicle costs are not covered under any head of this policy. Reference Case 35 confirms t = 0 for this scenario.
